defects.title: [Security] Missing Content Security Policy (CSP)
defects.summary: No Content-Security-Policy header is present. Without a CSP, the browser will execute any injected scripts, making the site highly vulnerable to Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) attacks.
reproductionSteps: 3. Verify evidence: Header "content-security-policy" absent from all response headers.
defects.expectedBehavior: HTTP headers and cookies should adhere to security hardening best practices.
defects.actualBehavior: Header "content-security-policy" absent from all response headers.
defects.rootCauseAnalysis: No Content-Security-Policy header is present. Without a CSP, the browser will execute any injected scripts, making the site highly vulnerable to Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) attacks.
defects.likelyCauseExplanation: Web server or reverse proxy is configured with missing security headers or unflagged session cookies.
defects.suggestedFix: Implement a strict CSP: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none';

defects.title: [Security] Missing Permissions-Policy Header
defects.summary: No Permissions-Policy header is set. This grants third-party embedded content unrestricted access to browser APIs like camera, microphone, geolocation, and USB.
defects.expectedBehavior: HTTP headers and cookies should adhere to security hardening best practices.
defects.rootCauseAnalysis: No Permissions-Policy header is set. This grants third-party embedded content unrestricted access to browser APIs like camera, microphone, geolocation, and USB.
defects.likelyCauseExplanation: Web server or reverse proxy is configured with missing security headers or unflagged session cookies.
defects.suggestedFix: Add: Permissions-Policy: geolocation=(), camera=(), microphone=(), usb=()
